# Route validation matrix

<!-- Generated by `node spikes/vue3-migration/route-matrix.mjs` from the two routers and `route-matrix.json`. Edit the JSON, not this file. -->

V02 ([#1284](https://github.com/Gero-Labs/gerowallet/issues/1284)) asks for a documented matrix that maps every shipped route to its V07–V11 work package and a validation method, including manual hardware checks. This is that matrix for the routes in `src/modules/navigation/router.ts` and `src/sidepanel/router.ts` as committed. The owner is the route component's primary work package from `routes.mjs`, the same rule as the V01 inventory; V04 owns redirects and catch-alls.

The ESLint Config Gate workflow runs `route-matrix.mjs --check`, so a route added or renamed without an entry in `route-matrix.json` fails the PR.

## How each route is checked

- **unit**: Vitest spec in this repository (npm test) that mounts the route's view or drives the logic behind it. Source-text tripwires are not listed.
- **guards**: src/modules/navigation/router.guards.spec.ts drives the production router with this route's auth, network or feature-flag guard.
- **help-browser**: scripts/help-browser scenario run by the Help browser evidence workflow on every PR.
- **e2e**: Playwright spec in the external harness, run against an exact wallet SHA.
- **manual**: Needs a device, a live provider, mainnet or funds; record the result in the V13 signoff.

E2E references are paths under `tests/specs` in [Gero-Labs/gerowallet-e2e-tests](https://github.com/Gero-Labs/gerowallet-e2e-tests) at harness `b5a00dc3`, whose wallet pin is `e8a3d139`. They are not checked out here, so route-matrix.mjs checks only their shape; rerun the harness against the exact candidate in V13 (#1295). A check marked funded skips without a funded testnet wallet and is not coverage until that run has one.

## Summary

- 54 routes: 46 options, 8 sidepanel.
- By owner: V04 4, V08 10, V09 8, V10 5, V11 27.
- 44 routes have at least one automated check that runs without a funded wallet.
- 10 routes have no such check and rely on the manual step: `options:/nexus`, `options:/governance/dreps/:drepId`, `options:/copilot-feed`, `options:/dev-tools`, `options:/wc-session-proposal`, `options:/warning`, `options:/ordinals`, `options:/lightning`, `sidepanel:/perps`, `sidepanel:/:pathMatch(.*)*`.
- 4 routes have browser coverage only in specs that skip without a funded wallet: `sidepanel:/staking`, `sidepanel:/market`, `sidepanel:/perps`, `sidepanel:/vaults`.
- 34 routes list a manual step (device, live provider, mainnet or funds) for the V13 signoff.
